name: Technology dividend + restitution financing engine
scope: Proposed economic institution; no enacted federal AI dividend, no current assessed AI restitution revenue

accounts.label: Restitution account
accounts.purpose: Make identifiable rightsholders whole for evidenced claims

accounts.label: Universal technology dividend
accounts.purpose: Return publicly captured incremental technology gains to eligible adults
accounts.entitlement_status: policy proposal; no automatic legal right

accounts.label: Permanent capital reserve
accounts.purpose: Build a sustainable endowment using realized receipts and prudent asset valuation

accounts.label: Governance/verification
accounts.purpose: Administrative, evidentiary and audit costs, with public independent oversight

revenue_channels.name: Dedicated levy on realized net AI-related income
revenue_channels.capture_basis: Taxable profits, not gross revenue or capital expenditure

revenue_channels.name: Licensing or royalty on specifically identified public assets or infrastructure
revenue_channels.mechanism_status: new contracts and legally valid licensing required

revenue_channels.name: Public-equity and sovereign technology portfolio returns
revenue_channels.capture_basis: Realized dividends, distributions and lawfully appropriable investment income
revenue_channels.mechanism_status: capital, governance, risk and enabling authority required

revenue_channels.name: Public compute, spectrum, right-of-way or access fees
revenue_channels.capture_basis: Legally collectible net receipts from identified rights/services

revenue_channels.name: Identified recoveries from proven wrongful takings
revenue_channels.capture_basis: Settlements, recoveries or judgments actually collected
revenue_channels.mechanism_status: case-by-case entitlement, not automatically a universal fund

source_evidence.title: Federal Reserve AI Buildout and the Economy, July 2026
source_evidence.finding: AI-related investment and measured spending contributions; NOT proof of distributable net revenues

source_evidence.title: US Treasury Combined Statement FY2025
source_evidence.finding: Corporation income tax receipts $452.1B in FY2025 across all US corporations; benchmark not earmarked or AI-attributed

source_evidence.title: Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend 2025 payment statistics
source_evidence.finding: 2025 dividend was $1,000; actual state program, not national financing proof

source_evidence.title: Alaska Permanent Fund Corporation structure
source_evidence.finding: Investment earnings and POMV draw contribute to budget and dividend under state laws

source_evidence.title: IMF AI Ecosystem Financing October 2026
source_evidence.finding: Financing of AI stack increasingly capital-intensive; projected CAPEX not profit

formulae.realized_net_annual_receipts: collected_tax + received_royalties + appropriable_investment_distributions + received_fees + legally_allocated_recoveries - collection_costs
formulae.protect_against_double_count: Do not count tax on tech company profits plus the same earnings as independent funding unless actually distinct legal flows

provenance_rules: Do not treat investment CAPEX, market capitalization, paper wealth or GDP contribution as cash distributable
Restitution claims require their own traced obligation and beneficiary
Do not conflate dollar stock historical deprivation and annual cash-flow entitlements
If receipts fall, dividends cannot exceed funded appropriable balance without explicit external financing
Avoid compensation overlap, preserve original title and settlement credits
Government, corporate and public equity recipients require statutory/contractual authority
Separate model-design choices from official policies and numbers
open_work: Estimate US incremental AI-attributable taxable profit without double counting
Model firm and capital mobility plus employment and price effects
Verify exact eligible population by year
Define legally enforceable public asset equity and royalty rights
Protect restitution rights from being diluted into universal pool
